home.faq_subtitle: Clear, honest answers about how payments, delivery, and prices work on KisanMandi.
home.faq_q1: How do I pay for my order?
home.faq_a1: We currently support Cash on Delivery (COD) only. You pay the exact agreed price to the farmer or delivery person once you receive and inspect your fresh produce.
home.faq_a2: Delivery is coordinated directly between the customer and the farmer once the order is accepted. Farmers dispatch produce to your address using local logistics or direct pickup.
home.faq_q3: How are farmers verified on the platform?
home.faq_a3: Farmers submit their farm details along with an agricultural proof document (such as 7/12 extract or farmer certificate). Our administrative team reviews each submission before granting selling rights.
home.faq_q4: Where do the mandi prices come from?
home.faq_a4: Mandi rates are fetched daily from the official Agmarknet portal via Open Government Data (data.gov.in). These represent wholesale modal market rates; individual retail prices may differ.
home.faq_q5: Can I use KisanMandi in Hindi or Marathi?
home.faq_a5: Yes! You can switch the entire application between English, Hindi (हिन्दी), and Marathi (मराठी) anytime using the language selector in the navigation bar.
home.faq_a6: There are no platform listing fees or hidden buyer commissions shown in this project demo. What you see is the direct farm rate agreed upon with the grower.

help.page_subtitle: Easy step-by-step guides for farmers and customers. Learn how to order, sell, and check mandi rates.
help.cust_step_1_desc: Browse by vegetables, fruits, or grains using large visual category tiles. Filter by distance to find farmers nearest to you.
help.cust_step_2_desc: Every product shows transparent pricing benchmarked against daily official Agmarknet wholesale rates. No inflated supermarket markups.
help.cust_step_3_desc: Select how many kilos you need and enter your doorstep delivery location. No complicated digital payment needed.
help.cust_step_4_desc: Receive farm-fresh produce directly from the grower. Inspect the harvest first, then pay in cash (100% Cash on Delivery).
help.farmer_step_1_desc: Create your free farmer profile using your mobile number and district in Maharashtra. Verified by admin for trustworthiness.
help.farmer_step_2_desc: Snap a photo of your vegetables or grain, enter the available quantity (in kg or quintal), and set your desired selling price.
help.farmer_step_3_desc: Get direct order requests from conscious households and local buyers in your area. Zero middleman cuts or dalal fees.
help.farmer_step_4_desc: Hand over your produce at the agreed delivery point and collect full 100% cash payment on the spot.
help.faq_cod_q: How do payments work? Do I need online banking?
help.faq_cod_a: No online banking or card is needed! KisanMandi operates on 100% Cash on Delivery. You only pay cash after the produce arrives at your doorstep.
help.faq_voice_q: How does the "Listen / सुनें" button work?
help.faq_voice_a: On modern phones, tapping the 🔊 "Listen" button reads today's mandi prices or product details out loud in Hindi, Marathi, or English. It helps users who prefer listening over reading.
help.faq_size_q: Can I make the text bigger if I have trouble reading?
help.faq_size_a: Yes! Tap the "A / A+ / A++" button in the top navigation bar to enlarge the text across the entire application instantly.
help.faq_mandi_q: Where do the Mandi rates come from?
help.faq_mandi_a: Wholesale mandi rates are synced daily from the official Government Agmarknet portal via data.gov.in (Open Government Data). They reflect real wholesale market rates across Maharashtra mandis.
help.faq_reg_a: Yes, KisanMandi is 100% free for farmers. There are no registration fees, listing fees, or commission deductions on your sales.
